body:
**Issue**:
When a player holds an orb in the physcannon, other players can punt the orb and influence its ownership, causing the previous owner i.e. the one who is holding the orb to be disintegrated in some situations.

**Fix**:
Prevent any external influence from modifying how the held orb behaves until it is let go.

author: seldridge
body:
Add the ability to set `$value$plusarg` and `$test$plusargs` directly from
ChiselSim simulate APIs.  These can be specified using the lower level
options to the simulator or via the implicit common/backend-specific
options.  However, this new API is the intended way that these should be
set by the user going forward.

Add the ability to pass plusargs to svsim simulations.

Note: there is some ugliness here in that simulation options are passed to functions that are doing "compilation".  This is a software architecture problem in svsim as evidenced by backend compilation options including runtime options (for VCS).  This all needs to be cleaned up separately.

#### Release Notes

Add support for Verilog `$value$plusargs` and `$test$plusargs` to svsim and ChiselSim.

This PR adds tests (tests/rt_action) for using the various real time actions with sigusr1, sigusr2 and sigalrm. The standard realtime actions in v14.1.0  are:
- sst.rt.exit.clean
- sst.rt.exit.emergency
- sst.rt.status.core
- sst.rt.status.all
- sst.rt.heartbeat
- sst.rt.checkpoint

The sigusr1/2 tests run the sst simulation in the background and use `kill -sigusr<1/2> <PID>` to send the signal.

Support for using sigusr1/2 to break into an interactive console is a new feature in sst-core that I've been working on. 
- sst.rt.interactive

The sigusr_interactive-DEV.sh test won't run unless you have the associated version of sst-core.  This test creates a pipe to allow the script to direct commands to the interactive console.

All the tests use a combination of return code and grep for expected output in an output file to determine PASS/FAIL.
